correctness.rationale: The edge-increment identity is exact: C_{j,k}=P_max−P_jP_k=P_max(1−P_min)>0. Fixing the remaining arms, the Cauchy--Schwarz upper bound on the within-arm quadratic and the opposing-linear term is simultaneously achievable only for full-length collinear increments, forcing radial arm geometry. The remaining Hilbert optimization is the polygon minimum residual delta, attainable in dimension 2; equality gives all maximizers and eta gives the exact one-dimensional threshold. The packaged independent arithmetic checker verifies 3,240 exact covariance calculations and 270 finite scalar comparisons; finite samples do not replace proof.

value.rationale: Determines the exact positive-weight Hilbert-valued nonlinear Lipschitz-to-centered-L² norm on an infinite structured metric family, every extremal map, and the minimal dimension (one or two). Whereas the scalar metric has a discrete signed-partition residual, the Hilbert residual is an explicit linear-time polygon imbalance. This resolves the entire weighted family, including nonuniform arm depths, and exhibits a strict dimension gap already for the uniform three-leaf star. It is a motivated exact maximum-variance-unfolding result, not a table recomputation.
